headline: AI Data Center Demand Boosts UK Manufacturing Growth to 16-Month High
summary: Orders for artificial intelligence data centers drove UK factory output growth to its highest level since July 2024 in November, though the composite PMI edged down to 52.3.
why: The S&P Global UK PMI measures health in manufacturing and services sectors across the United Kingdom.

impacts.name: United Kingdom
impacts.why: UK factory growth accelerated on strong demand from AI data center investments.
